identity.title: C-SDLC v2 execution-proof receipts cannot bind a committed evidence head without self-reference

values.task_boundary: Add an explicit two-revision v3 proof contract and focused regression without migrating retained receipts or changing Runtime product code.
deliverables: Exact-head review and qualified issue-closing implementation PR
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A tracked execution-proof receipt can be committed without requiring an infinite sequence of HEAD rewrites
AC-2: The validator distinguishes substantive source revision from evidence-only commit revision
AC-3: Both revisions and their ancestry are machine-verified
AC-4: Every A..B changed path is confined to declared issue evidence and receipt paths
AC-5: Tampering with source, test, logs, or receipt still fails closed
AC-6: Focused regression covers substantive commit A followed by evidence-only commit B plus later metadata C and named rejection cases
AC-7: Retained v2 receipts are not reinterpreted or migrated
AC-8: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings
dependencies: Existing WP-04 proof receipt v2 contract
Git ancestry and diff pathspec behavior
non_goals: Runtime or distributed Guardian product changes
Migration or rewriting of retained receipts
Weakening any artifact or runner provenance digest
General redesign of all ADL evidence formats
